traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified:
- File-Level Template (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER): when a test file lacks any @supports annotation, `ensureFileSupportsAnnotation` reports `missingFileSupports` and, when `autoFixTestTemplate` is true, adds a file-level JSDoc with a placeholder `@supports docs/stories/XXX.X-STORY-NAME.story.md REQ-XXX-YYY REQ-XXX-ZZZ` plus a TODO line. The tests assert the exact before/after text. - Format Fixes (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT): `normalizeReqPrefixInDescription` and `handleItOrTestCall` implement and apply spacing, underscore, casing, and parentheses normalization of leading REQ prefixes. Tests cover all described malformed formats and confirm the expected normalized outputs. - Template Quality: the inserted template contains obvious placeholder story path and REQ IDs plus an explicit TODO sentence guiding developers, matching the story’s requirement for clear placeholders. - Quality Standards & Safety (REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE): auto-fixes only touch comments and test name string literals. They preserve quote style and escape sequences, never modify test implementation code, and only apply when the rule can unambiguously normalize an existing REQ prefix. For missing prefixes, the rule reports an error without adding a prefix, as required. - Integration: the rule is part of the main plugin (`src/index.ts` RULE_NAMES includes `require-test-traceability`), has `meta.fixable: 'code'`, and tests via ESLint RuleTester confirm that fixes are applied in `--fix` mode. Jest test output shows this suite passing. - User Experience: all auto-fixes are localized and predictable; tests confirm that correctly formatted prefixes are left unchanged and that malformed ones are normalized to a consistent `[REQ-...]` style. - Error Handling: guards ensure fixes are only attached when safe (recognizable REQ pattern and literal string argument). Otherwise, the rule only reports violations, satisfying the story’s safety and no-inference constraints. - Documentation: user-docs/api-reference.md documents both the validation and auto-fix behaviors and configuration switches corresponding to this story.
Given the implemented code, passing targeted tests, and up-to-date documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes.
